master.name: trg_locations_set_path_on_update

UPDATE locations SET path = CASE WHEN new.parent_location_id IS NULL THEN '/' || new.id || '/' ELSE (SELECT path FROM locations l2 WHERE l2.id = new.parent_location_id) || new.id || '/' END WHERE id = new.id; -- Rewrite every descendant (recursive walk). UPDATE locations SET path = (SELECT l2.path FROM locations l2 WHERE l2.id = locations.parent_location_id) || locations.id || '/' WHERE id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS ( SELECT id FROM locations WHERE parent_location_id = new.id AND id <> new.id UNION ALL SELECT l.id FROM locations l JOIN sub s ON l.parent_location_id = s.id ) SELECT id FROM sub ); END
